name: Etoricoxib + Thiocolchicoside
meta: Etoricoxib: Selective COX-2 inhibitor (NSAID); Thiocolchicoside: Centrally acting muscle relaxant (colchicoside derivative)
Prescription-only fixed-dose combination. Components – Etoricoxib: Schedule H –
prescription only; Thiocolchicoside: Schedule H – prescription only
sections: White to off-white powder, slightly soluble in water.
Yellow crystalline powder, soluble in water.

Etoricoxib: The MEDAL programme (34,701 patients) showed thrombotic cardiovascular event rates comparable to diclofenac with fewer upper GI events. First approval/introduction: Patented 1996; approved 2002 (Merck & Co.) – approved in >80 countries, not in the USA. Thiocolchicoside: A semi-synthetic sulfur derivative of colchicoside (from Gloriosa superba). In 2013 the EMA restricted oral use to 7 days and IM to 5 days because a metabolite caused aneuploidy in vitro. First approval/introduction: Introduced in France in the 1950s–60s (Roussel).
Etoricoxib reduces inflammatory pain once daily; thiocolchicoside relieves reflex muscle spasm. Together they break the pain–spasm–pain cycle in acute musculoskeletal disorders.

Etoricoxib Highly selective inhibitor of cyclo-oxygenase-2, reducing prostaglandin synthesis at sites of inflammation while largely sparing COX-1-mediated gastric protection and platelet function. Receptor / target profile: Highly selective COX-2 inhibitor (~106-fold COX-2 over COX-1 in human whole-blood assays).

Thiocolchicoside Competitive GABA-A receptor antagonist and glycine-receptor modulator with myorelaxant action at supraspinal level; relieves painful muscle spasm. Receptor / target profile: Competitive GABA-A and glycine receptor antagonist; suspected nicotinic receptor antagonism.
Summary: Bioavailability ~100%; Tmax ~1 h. ~92% protein bound. Metabolised by CYP3A4. Half-life ~22 h (once-daily dosing).
Hydrolysed to 3-demethylthiocolchicine (aglycone), then glucuronidated to active SL18.0740
Summary: Oral bioavailability ~25%; metabolised to active 3-demethylthiocolchicine glucuronide (SL18.0740). Half-life of active metabolite 3–5 h.
